  "passageText": "HALL'S ANALOGY FOR APPROACHING INTERCULTURAL UNDERSTANDING.\nThe concept of the cultural iceberg was coined in 1976 by Edward T Hall, who suggested that culture is analogous to an iceberg in that only about 10% of the iceberg is visible at any given time and that a large part of it is hidden beneath the surface.
